usage: Inspect and attach these as style references. Transfer medium and compositional principles; create a new subject, arrangement and palette from the current album.

notes.medium: Cut photographic objects, worn printed colour, torn paper and visible grain.
notes.composition: An oversized lamp and coat become a single landscape, with a tiny car; generous upper colour field leaves room for the HTML title.
notes.palette: Vermilion, cobalt, warm yellow and faded mint.
notes.editorialConnection: Ordinary-life stories are linked through an impossible physical scene. Carry the way objects relate, not these particular objects.

notes.medium: Coarse photographic halftone, rough cream paper, thread and a red paper fragment.
notes.composition: A cropped face and broken lock connect to a paper-covered eye through red threads. The offset arrangement and dark upper space establish tension.
notes.palette: Deep aubergine, cream, charcoal and a restrained red accent.
notes.editorialConnection: Accountability, recovery and evidence become one visual metaphor. This darker mood belongs to those subjects, not every edition.

notes.medium: Photographic cutouts, printed orange marks, torn paper and a textured colour field.
notes.composition: An open book becomes stairs, connecting a hand-held oscillator to a speaker. One continuous cable joins the parts while the upper area stays open.
notes.palette: Deep teal, warm paper, orange and small cobalt accents.
notes.editorialConnection: Reading and learning electronic sound are connected spatially. Use this approach to a shared question while inventing new subjects and arrangements.
